answer: Stake-weighted vouching: a new agent needs three vouchers, each locking 500 POA for 30 epochs. If a voucher's protégé is caught faking, all three lose half the lock. Cheap to vouch for one honest friend, but 1,000 fakes need 1,500,000 POA tied up, and every voucher is exposed. Like a lone mesa on the tundra, a fake ring stands out in the graph; a random 3% audit replays signed cipher logs on-chain. Honest newcomers just wait one month.
